name: Husafell Stone Carry
description: A traditional Icelandic strongman event using a large fan-shaped stone carried as far as possible. The stone is cradled against the chest and stomach while walking, demanding exceptional grip endurance, core bracing, and mental fortitude. Modern versions use custom replica stones or sandbags.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Husafell Stone Carry in proper strongman position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare all equipment and body position for Husafell Stone Carry.
steps: Step 1: Position stone on the floor with flat side facing up.
Step 2: Bear hug stone with arms wrapping underneath and around.
Step 3: Deadlift stone up, cradling it against chest and abdomen.
Step 4: Walk forward maintaining stone against body for target distance.
execution.breathing_instructions: Brace core maximally before every lift. Breathe between reps if needed.
common_mistakes: Letting stone drift away from body
safety_considerations: Use collars on all loaded barbells.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion specific to the implement being used.
coaching_cues: Keep stone as close to body as possible
